topic.readerProblem: Separate ChatGPT-assisted work, labeled advertising, and organic recommendation visibility so each receives the right strategy and measurement.
topic.connection: Explains the organic brand-visibility outcome AEOeye audits and how teams can improve the public evidence behind it.

assessment: Reviewed the three-job distinction, OpenAI product references, crawler guidance, 90-day plan, measurement model, internal links, images, and FAQs. The article states that ads do not buy organic recommendations, separates OAI-SearchBot from GPTBot, and makes no promise that content or access controls will cause ChatGPT to cite a brand.
